Mod.Name: Cage Expansion
Mod.Author: Lethecus
Mod.Description:
Want to help make the mod better? Report bugs and logs at https://tally.so/r/0V85KB so we can keep it working for you.
The animal cage stops at eight size upgrades, which is not much room once a few rats are breeding. This raises that cap so one cage can be taller, in the mod settings.
Overcrowding in the game is not a per-animal flag - it is how full the cage is. The game compares the total size of the animals inside against the cage's cell count, and starts rolling nightly harm above 55, 70 and 90 percent. More rows means more cells, so the same number of rats sits at a lower percentage.
Each extra row still costs one metal ingot and still adds the usual durability, so nothing is free, there is just more cage to buy.
https://github.com/lethecus/probably-stolen-mods The source for all my mods if you wish to confirm nothing shady going on.
